sections.title: Who's That Noisy

sections.text:
Item #1: Scientists report that they have successfully used CRISPR to fix a disease-causing gene mutation in a newly fertilized egg, effectively curing the disease and preventing its further inheritance.
Item #2: Researchers have demonstrated that by analyzing millions of tweets they can predict the perpetrators of specific crimes.
Item #3: A new genetic analysis finds that scorpions and spiders share a common ancestor.
sections.title: Science or Fiction

sections.text: 'If someone is able to show me that what I think or do is not right, I will happily change, for I seek the truth, by which no one was ever truly harmed. It is the person who continues in his self-deception and ignorance who is harmed.' - Marcus Aurelius
